params.name: CV0
params.source: ref s3 G2: ~1,030-1,110 decoded mirrors of 17.93 MiB expected

params.name: beta
params.source: slope of miss curve: 0.42-0.47 Zipf-IRM fit to M0; 0.55 Oct replay (70% VRAM, 45.8 reads @57 slots/layer); 0.71 M0<->V4 LRU two-point; ~1.0 local marginal of Oct VRAM sweep 1530->2000

params.name: mA
params.source: M0 R0c: hit 34.6-37.1 % with 360 records (9 slots/layer) cached

params.name: sigma
params.source: ASSUMED per-layer heterogeneity of miss rate (lognormal sd)

params.name: q
params.source: ASSUMED fraction of VRAM misses prefetched in time; V4 live 9-15 demand + ~71 prefetch reads/token

params.name: w_extra
params.source: ASSUMED wasted prefetch reads per demand disk miss

params.name: T0
params.source: non-expert-I/O time per token after G2 [ASSUMED]; V4 64GB A/B: attn 34.6 + hc 14.4 + GPU 13.9 ms + rest

params.name: cfix
params.source: per VRAM-miss attach/publish overhead; V4 A1 attach 35.6 ms/token incl. upload

params.name: cdec_x
params.source: WNR batch (W2) time beyond the PCIe floor: V4 b8 0.281 vs 0.22; V4.1 b8 0.402 vs 0.324 (shared GPU)

params.name: csingle
params.source: WNR single-record helper per record without W2: V4.1 single 0.718-0.759 (shared GPU), V4 helper ~1.0 ms

params.name: kappa
params.source: GPU contention per ms of decode kernel: bench_prio WNR2 decode inflates fg chain ~29 %

params.name: cv1
params.source: in-VRAM single-record decode latency: rechunk 2048:512 0.1998 ms, task brief ~0.2 ms

params.name: cvtp
params.source: in-VRAM decode throughput cost/record: 17.93 MiB / ~100 GiB/s (8 in flight) = 0.175 ms

params.name: slot_ov
params.source: fixed slot = largest record (crc code): per-layer mean 3.747-3.852 bit/w -> max ~+1.7 % + within-layer spread; 1.00 = byte-capped LRU

params.name: R_tot
params.source: RAM for expert records, GiB: M0 6.30 GiB slots + W3 4 GiB cache = 10.3; 32 GB machine

params.name: crc_share
params.source: share of that RAM held as compressed-record cache (W3: 4 of 10.3 GiB); 1.0 = all compressed

params.name: bw_scale
params.source: drive throughput uncertainty (thermal guard hit U: at 75 C in Oct, fragmentation)

params.name: qmix
params.source: ASSUMED weight of M/D/1 queueing of demand reads behind prefetch reads (0 = demand has priority)

M0 two-point fit (serial, no overlap).note: vs ~214 misses/token [inferred] in ref s12 and 240*(1-0.346..0.371)=151-157 from the M0 hit rate

plan32.note: from 3 clean repeat pairs on V4/64 GB; a disk-bound 32 GB machine with NVMe thermals is likely noisier
